item.title: [New] Windows at Ignite: IAKerb lets Windows 11 use Kerberos without line of sight to a DC, Windows Hello event logs record Face, Fingerprint or PIN unlocks, web sign-in reaches hybrid joined devices
item.description:
IAKerb removes a common reason Windows clients fall back to NTLM, and the new Windows Hello events give the SOC a record of how a device was unlocked; remote lock is a containment action that keeps the evidence on the disk.

Windows · Plan IAKerb into the NTLM-retirement work (audit NTLM use first), decide where the Windows Hello event logs will be collected, and add remote lock to the lost-device and compromised-device playbooks.
